name: Git Operations
description: MANDATORY for all git operations. Enforces Conventional Commits format, staging rules, branch naming, push/PR/merge safety rules, and the session-end commit protocol. No agent may run a git command without reading this skill first.

name: Grammarly Polish
description: On-demand final content polish via Grammarly in Chrome. Use for high-stakes content only (Forbes articles, board decks, podcast scripts, emails, LinkedIn posts). Pass content in-context; returns Grammarly score, corrections, tone assessment, and a corrected version. NOT a default pipeline step — invoke explicitly only.

name: Boot Reminder Registry
description: System-wide skill to write boot-time reminders to data/reminders.json. Any agent calls this to surface a question to David at a future boot, with a routable action_prompt that executes on yes and self-removes on acknowledgment.

name: Session Index
description: Read/write session continuity index — topics, loops, boot

name: OmniFocus Task Creation
description: Creates OmniFocus tasks with project + tag enforcement

name: reMarkable Agent Delivery
description: Agent-initiated PDF delivery to the reMarkable tablet via rmapi. Enforces naming convention (human-readable, no dates, no slugs) and path routing rules by document type. Use for workflow-driven pushes; for interactive uploads use .claude/skills/remarkable-upload/SKILL.md.

name: Weather
description: Gets current weather conditions and forecasts for a city, region, or airport code via wttr.in (no API key required).
